say:2:1230519001:1.text: Tsk, if we keep piling 'em up here they'll just get damp and rusty.
say:2:1230519001:1.source_cn: 啧，继续堆在这里也只能受潮。
say:2:1230519001:1.male: Tsk, if we keep piling 'em up here they'll just get damp and rusty.
say:2:1230519001:1.female: Tsk, if we keep piling 'em up here they'll just get damp and rusty.

say:3:1230519002:1.text: Clay, give us a hand now! Load the canons onboard and we'll sell them in Rustport. Once we're flush with coin we'll adjust course to the tavern!
say:3:1230519002:1.source_cn: 卡利欧，帮把手！把这些炮装船，咱们去锈锚港倒卖一笔。拿...

say:4:1230519003:1.text: I'm coming! Don't think you're crawlin' into a bottle without me!
say:4:1230519003:1.source_cn: 来了来了，喝酒可少不了我！
